name: grok-lab
description: 4 viral-grade experiments built on xAI Grok (voice roasts, reference client, voice+imagine, thread machine)

scripts.dev: echo 'Run one app at a time (or in separate terminals / different ports):' && echo '  npm run dev:roast | dev:lab | dev:imagine | dev:threads  (or npm run dev:all)'
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/roast-voice install && npm --prefix apps/voice-lab install && npm --prefix apps/voice-imagine install && npm --prefix apps/grok-threads install
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix apps/roast-voice run build && npm --prefix apps/voice-lab run build && npm --prefix apps/voice-imagine run build && npm --prefix apps/grok-threads run build
scripts.test: node packages/xai-client/test/audio.test.js && echo 'Basic audio utils smoke test passed' || echo 'Tests would be expanded with vitest for parsers + realtime events'
